title: Bin bhai ke ab
body:
ay bhaiya mere bhaiya
haye hussain pyase hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bin bhai ke ab kaise watan jayegi zainab
mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
poochegi jo sughra ke kahan hai mere baba
mujhko mera baysheer nazar kyun nahi aata
sab qatl huwe kaise bata payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab chaahne waale hai mere karbobala mein
sab godh ke paale hai isi dasht e jafa mein
yeh kehte huwe jahan se guzar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e masayib se to laut aayi hoon bhaiya
par saath sakina ko kahan laayi hoon bhaiya
ye daagh kaleje pe na seh payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek hi aaram hai is qalb e hazeen ko
bazaar ke sab zakhm abhi yaad hai mujhko
baaghi ki behan ab nahi kehlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ke makeen poochenge sajjad se aa kar
pardes mein barbaad hua kaise bhara ghar
khoon royega sajjad to ghabrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayenge nazar aun o mohamed ke jo hujre
ho jayenge sab zakhm hare mere jigar ke
jab aun o mohamed ko nahi payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kohe sitam qalb pe nani ke girega
amma ki lehad kaamp uthegi mere bhaiya
jab neel rasan ke unhe dikhlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun aayi nahi saath mein farzand tumhare
gar pooch liya mujhse ye abdulla ne aa ke
sau baar wohi waqeya dohrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar wo ghadi kaisi thi mai likh nahi sakta
mehmil se nazar aaya jo zainab ko madina
fizza ne kaha dard se mar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
author: Mazhar Abidi
